name: get_performance_report
description: Retrieves the performance report for a portfolio with gains, holdings breakdown, and benchmarks

start_date.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD (defaults to portfolio inception)

consolidated.description: Set to true for consolidated portfolio views

report_combined.description: Receive combined totals for same instruments across portfolios

grouping.description: Group by: country, currency, custom_group, industry_classification, investment_type, market, portfolio, sector_classification, ungrouped

include_limited.description: Include holdings limited by user plan

name: list_portfolios
description: Retrieves a list of the user's portfolios. Optionally filter by consolidated view or instrument.

consolidated.description: Set to true to see consolidated portfolio views

instrument_id.description: Filter by instrument ID. When set, consolidated defaults to false
